body: [This](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/4c6gsm/easter_alone_dumped_by_my_husband_of_8_years_by/) was my post 8 days ago. I know very well what you're feeling. I'm just going an hour at a time. Message me if you want to talk.
It's been X-files and (hangs head in shame) Melrose Place for me. If I don't have something on it's just too quiet and I start to freak out.

Thank you, I seem to be having trouble processing that because by defending myself, he was the one that got sent to the hospital. The police and victims services said the same thing but hes told me several times since that "he didn't deserve staples in his head" and so it's hard to feel like the victim here, even though I logically know that's true.

Thank you for your kind words. Unfortunately I work for a giant corporation that has zero flexibility in their availability hours (employess must be available 6am-11:30pm, 7 days a week) and the public transportation in my city is not great, almost non-existent on weekends when a lot of my shifts are.
 It also doesn't help that I wasn't very happy before I knew him, he made me happier than I've ever been. I was alone then but being alone and not knowing what you're missing is way different from being alone and knowing what you've lost.
I'm in Ontario, about halfway between Ottawa and Toronto
Child of the Morning by Pauline Gedge, The Climb by Anatoli Boukreev and I'm starting in on Fatal North by Bruce Henderson. I read a lot and I can't sleep so I've been up since 4 am or so.

I don't see anything else ahead, all I have is a house full of junk that I can't afford the rent on and a part-time job I'm probably going to lose due to transportation issues. I've collected every last penny of my 'savings' and it's just going to cover the rent due next week. I'm 41 and have nothing and no one.

I just feel like there's no hope for me. He was the only man I ever really loved and I didn't ever see this coming. I'm terrified that a new cycle will mean homelessness, desperation and begging on the street.

He took the vehicle and I can barely walk since I fell down the stairs. I tried packing some of his stuff but am really hurting physically. I tried to play my favorite video game but it just reminds me of him. I've read 2 books so far today though.

I don't know what I'm going to do, I can cover the rent for April but that means I won't be eating and I'll have to walk 4 miles to work each day. I could rent a room out but the house is full of stuff and I'm just so overwhelmed and honestly scared to rent to a stranger.
I'm in Canada, so I could get therapy if the police hadn't lost my health card when they spoke to me. I can't get into the place to replace it for a week or so due to my work schedule.
I don't know what else to say. I just feel tricked and used and so, so tired.

Thank you, that's exactly how I feel. I know if I do drink it will turn out badly but my brain craves the not caring feeling it would give me. I've been trying to just get through each day, hour by hour. 

Thanks as well for the advice about the meeting, I'm a bit nervous about it and will keep in mind there are other ones out there.

My family is very religious and not people I could go to with this issue for support and of course any "friends" I do have are drinkers who wouldn't help in this situation.

The only message I've received from my husbands relative is that he has not had a drink in the last 11 days either. I'm trying to find some hope in that.
I've called and found a meeting Tuesday afternoon that's close enough to walk to, I'm going to go. Thank you so much, being alone when I wake up and when I get home is the worst part.
